page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It does not feature any graphics processing units. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

With a high density of dedicated Intel Xeon compute cores relative to memory, the ecs.c6t.26xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. This hardware profile is suited for high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive web serving, and compute-bound distributed workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, alongside 192.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a low memory-to-CPU ratio of approximately 1.85 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage options. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Given its high core count and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.c6t.26xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads such as batch processing, high-performance computing, and large-scale web serving where high parallel processing capability is required without the need for massive memory allocations or local disk storage.
